reasons: Errors are hidden from the caller.
No tests are visible in the packet.

terms.meaning: A short summary of the user's current profile sent to the AI for context.
A formal credential or course completion.

sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Imports and time limit
sections.what: Brings in the request tools and AI helper, and allows 30 seconds for the request.
sections.why: Keeps the scan quick because it runs while the user types.

sections.name: ProfileSuggestion
sections.title: Suggestion shape
sections.what: Describes one suggestion: its type, a description of what was found, and the exact text to add.
sections.why: Gives a fixed format for the results.
sections.watch_out: Types are not checked at runtime, so the AI could return a type the app does not expect.

sections.name: POST (part 1)
sections.title: Build the scanning prompt
sections.what: Summarizes the current profile and the text, and writes rules telling the AI to suggest only clearly new, personal facts.
sections.why: The rules keep suggestions accurate and few.
sections.watch_out: Only the first 2000 characters of text are scanned, so later content is ignored.

sections.name: POST (part 2)
sections.title: Clean up suggestions
sections.what: Keeps only suggestions with all required parts filled in, and returns at most three.
sections.why: Filters out incomplete AI output before the user sees it.
sections.watch_out: Errors are swallowed here too, so the user never learns why nothing appeared.

summary: Scans a piece of text the user wrote and suggests up to three new skills, certifications, achievements, or preferences to add to their profile.
purpose: Keeps the profile up to date without the user re-entering details.
why: Likely reason: the user may mention useful facts in their writing that never reach the profile.
how: Builds a prompt with a short profile snapshot and the first 2000 characters of the text, asks the AI for suggestions, removes incomplete suggestions, and returns up to three.
inputs: Text, the profile, and optional provider settings. Text under 40 characters is ignored.
outputs: A suggestions list. Any failure returns an empty list.
risks: All errors are swallowed, so a failure looks the same as finding nothing.
debug: If nothing appears, confirm the text is at least 40 characters, then check the AI reply in chatJSON.
